```{R}
rm(list=ls())
library(stringr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
x1<-read.beast("E:/My Drive/finaltree.tree")
#0427 allpop coalescent tree
allx<-read.beast("E:/My Drive/0427_coalescentLTR_allpop")
metadata<-as.data.frame(read.csv(file="C:/Rdev/R2401/0224_TreePhylo/data/metadata/finallist_381_csv_1211.csv", header=TRUE)) %>%
  dplyr::filter(Accession != "KU214243.1")



x2<-allx%>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  mutate(label= gsub("\\|.*", "", label)) %>%
  left_join(., metadata, by = c("label"="Accession")) %>%
  mutate(label=gsub("\\.\\d$",'',label)) %>%
  as.treedata() 

#review nodes
ggtree(x2, layout="rectangular", open.angle=10, color="darkgray", size=1)+geom_text2(aes(subset=!isTip,label=node), hjust=-.3, size=1)+geom_tiplab(size=1)

ggsave("2405_beastraw1.pdf", plot = last_plot(),  path=("../../output/2405tree"), scale=1, dpi=300, limitsize=FALSE)



#basic tree with only main clades
xb1<-ggtree(x2, 
            layout="rectangular",
            size=1.2,
            mrsd="2020-01-01",
            aes(color=round(posterior, 2)),
            right=FALSE)+
  scale_color_viridis_c(name="Posterior", direction=-1) +
  new_scale_fill()+new_scale_color()+
  xlim(-40000, 2020) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks=c(-40000, -20000, -10000, -5000, 0, 2000), minor_breaks=seq(-5000, 2000, 500)) +
  theme(panel.grid.major   = element_line(color="black", size=.2),
        panel.grid.minor   = element_line(color="grey", size=.2),
        panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor.y = element_blank(),
        axis.line.x = element_line(color="black", size=.2)) +
  theme_tree2() 

xb2<-xb1 %>%
  scaleClade(754, 0.05) %>% #melaustrian
  scaleClade(744, 0.05) %>% #african
  scaleClade(385, 0.05) %>% #Japanese
  scaleClade(509, 0.05) %>% #TC
  collapse(754, 'min', fill="transparent") %>% 
  collapse(744, 'min', fill="transparent") %>% 
  collapse(385, 'min', fill="transparent") %>% 
  collapse(509, 'min', fill="transparent") +
  geom_range("CAheight_0.95_HPD", color='lightblue', size=5, alpha=.5)+
  geom_tippoint(aes(subset=(grepl('Peru',Country,fixed=TRUE)==TRUE)), color="#E41a1c",size=1.2, shape=16) 

dfclade2<-data.frame(node=c(754,744, 743, 385, 509),
                     Genotype=c("c-Melanesian","a-Africans","Afro-Peruvian","a-Transcontinental","a-Japanese"),
                     colourtype=c("#FFFF33", "#FF7F00", "#E31A1C","#984ea3","#1F78B4")) %>%
  left_join(., xb2$data, by=c("node"="node"))

xb3<-xb2+  new_scale_fill()+new_scale_color()+
  geom_point2(data=dfclade2, aes(node=node, color=Genotype, shape=Genotype, fill=Genotype), size=5, alpha=0.8) +
  scale_shape_manual(name="Genotype", values=c(21, 22, 23, 24, 25))+
  scale_color_manual(name="Genotype", values=dfclade2$colourtype)+
  scale_fill_manual(name="Genotype", values=dfclade2$colourtype) +
  geom_nodelab(aes(x=x, label=round(2020-CAheight_median)), vjust=-1, hjust=1.1, size=3, nudge_x = -0.0001) 
  
xb3

ggsave("2405_treebeast1slides.png", plot = last_plot(),  path="../../output/2405tree", scale=2, dpi=1200, limitsize=FALSE)
```

```{r}
################TREE WITH AFRICA ONLY (TRANSCONTINENTAL)
rm(list=ls())
#### 0427 allpop coalescent tree
beast_tree<-read.beast("/Users/denriquez/Documents/Rstats/R-main/data/0422/0520_beasttree_allpop_shortnames_nw")
metadata<-as.data.frame(read.csv(file="/Users/denriquez/Documents/Rstats/R-main/0224_TreePhylo/data/metadata/finallist_381_csv_1211.csv", header=TRUE))  %>%
  filter(Accession!= "KU214243.1")



## Joining with metadata
beast_tree2<-beast_tree%>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  mutate(label= gsub("\\|.*", "", label)) %>%
  left_join(., metadata, by = c("label"="Accession")) %>%
  mutate(label=gsub("\\.\\d$",'',label),
            label=gsub("_S[0-9]+$",'',label)) %>%
    as.treedata()

## review nodes
ggtree(beast_tree2, layout="rectangular", open.angle=10, color="lightgray", size=1)+geom_text2(aes(subset=!isTip,label=node), hjust=-.3, size=1)+geom_tiplab(size=1)


tree_subset=tree_subset(beast_tree2, node=382, levels_back=0)

ggtree(tree_subset, layout="rectangular", open.angle=10, color="lightgray", size=1)+geom_text2(aes(subset=!isTip,label=node), hjust=-.3, size=1)+geom_tiplab(size=1)
#basic tree with only main clades
## Adding tips
Peru_samples = tree_subset%>%
  as_tibble() |>
  filter(grepl("Peru", Country)) |>
  pull(label)

xb1<-ggtree(tree_subset, 
            layout="rectangular",
            size=.5,
            mrsd="2020-01-01",
            aes(color=round(posterior, 2)),
            right=FALSE) +
  scale_color_viridis_c(name="Posterior", direction=-1) +
  theme_tree2() 
xb1
## Collapsing Japanese Clade
adv_tree_1 = collapse(xb1, node=377) +
  geom_point2(aes(subset=(node==377)), shape=21, size=5, fill="#FF7F00", color="#FF7F00") 

## Collapsing African
adv_tree_2 = collapse(adv_tree_1, node=736) +
  geom_point2(aes(subset=(node==736)), shape=21, size=5, fill="#FFFF33", color="#FFFF33") 

## Collapsing TC-Jpn
adv_tree_3 = collapse(adv_tree_2, node=523) +
  geom_point2(aes(subset=(node==523)), shape=21, size=5, fill="#e2a466", color="#e2a466") 

adv_tree_3@data
treefinal = adv_tree_3 +
      theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
    geom_tiplab(
      geom = "text",
      aes(label = label, subset = label %in% Peru_samples),
      color = "red", face = "bold", size = 1.5, angle=0, offset=-100, hjust=-1,  align = TRUE
    ) +
    vexpand(-.5) +
    geom_nodelab(aes(x=x, label=round(height), subset=(height>2000 & posterior>0.8)), vjust=-1, hjust=1.1, size=3, nudge_x = -0.0001)
treefinal

ggsave(here::here("./2602_TC_tree.svg"), treefinal,  dpi = 600)
ggsave(here::here("./2602_TC_tree.tiff"), treefinal,  dpi = 600)
ggsave
geom_tiplab2(geom = "text",
      aes(label = label ,subset = label %in% Peru_samples
      ),
      color = "red", face = "bold", size = 1.5, offset = 0, angle=0, hjust=0, vjust=0) 
xb2<-xb1 %>%
  scaleClade(363, 0.05) %>% #a-Jpn
  scaleClade(521, 0.05) %>% #TC-Jpn
  collapse(363, 'min', fill="transparent") %>%
  collapse(521, 'min', fill="transparent") +
  geom_point2(aes(subset=(node==363)),size=5, fill="#FF7F00", color= "#FF7F00",alpha=0.9, shape=22) +
  geom_point2(aes(subset=(node==521)),size=5, fill="#FDBF6F", color= "#FDBF6F",alpha=0.9, shape=22) 
  


##modififyin Ca

## plotting with geom_segment()

   scale_fill_manual(guide="legend", name="Countries", values=c("#4daf4a","#984ea3","#a6761d","#E41a1c"), labels=c("Brazil", "Chile", "Japan","Peru"), na.value="black") +
  geom_nodelab(aes(x=x, label=round(2020-CAheight_median), subset=(height_median>1400)), vjust=-1, hjust=1.1, size=3, nudge_x = -0.0001)+
  new_scale_color() + new_scale_fill()
```
